::: typewriter
FOR MR PLATT ONLY. AS PROMISED BY MR PIKE, YOUR TARGET FIGURE FOLLOWS AS A WIRE PICTURE. STOP.

THE NUMBERS BESIDE EACH ROW AND ABOVE EACH COLUMN GIVE THE RUNS OF BLACK SQUARES, IN ORDER. STOP.

BLACKEN THE SQUARES AND READ THE FIGURE. STOP.
:::
